hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$CMD" == git* ]] && echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $CMD" >> ~/.claude/git-log.txt || true

CMD=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$CMD" == *"git commit"* ]] && bash ~/.claude/hooks/pre-commit-check.sh "$(pwd)" || true

FILE=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$FILE" == *.go ]] && (gofmt -w "$FILE" && echo '✅ gofmt 완료') || true

FILE=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$FILE" == *.fl ]] && echo '📝 FreeLang 파일 저장됨' || true

EXIT=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_response',{}).get('exitCode',0))" 2>/dev/null); CMD=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); ([[ "$CMD" == *"go test"* ]] || [[ "$CMD" == *"npm test"* ]]) && [[ "$EXIT" != "0" ]] && bash ~/.claude/hooks/self-healing-test.sh "$(pwd)" "$EXIT" || true
echo '🔍 검증 사이클 시작' && echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] 작업 시작" >> ~/.claude/work-log.txt
